goal: Implement R-016 SignalSpec validator, compiler, and authoring API so declarative signal specs can be validated, compiled, backtested, reviewed, and promoted with operator approval.
requirements: Add platform-dsl/signalspec validator and compiler targeting existing FeatureNode primitives.
Persist one row per SignalSpec plus YAML body.
Extend explainability envelope with author, signalId, signalVersion, proposalId, and trackRecord.
Add UI catalog view showing author and track record.
constraints: Do not add Java code generation for signals.
Do not allow auto-promotion without human/operator approval.
acceptance_criteria: LLM-authored equities.relativeVolumeZ.v1 round-trips propose, validate, compile, backtest, promote, and contributes to live ranking.
Validator rejects unknown op, unknown ref, cyclic transform, missing required field, and unknown apiVersion with actionable diagnostics.
Promoted signals show author provenance in opportunities.
